start.text: I'm the law in Grey Valley, such as it is. Keep your nose clean and we won't have trouble. Something on your mind?

choices.text: Any work for a capable hand?

work.text: Always. But I don't hand my badge to strangers. Earn some goodwill in town first, then we'll talk.

trouble.text: Black Dog Gang's been bolder lately. I've six deputies and they've got sixty guns. You do the math. If they hit the farms, I can't be everywhere.
